# Name: # Single-app layout on the board's 16MB flash.
# Offsets below 0x120000 are deliberately UNCHANGED from the 2MB layout: moving them would
# relocate the ffc partition and discard a stored flat-field table
# released merged binaries incompatible. The app is ~509KB
# The FFC offset table is 256*192 int8 = 48KB plus a 16-byte header; NVS at 24KB cannot hold it.
# A raw partition avoids NVS blob overhead and lets it be written in one erase+write.
# Everything else: 0x1000000 - 0x120000 = 0xEE0000 = 14.875MB. Declared but NOT mounted - nothing
